about: Assistant AutoX held-out set: questions written by the site's owner, never by whoever tunes the prompt or the server, and never used to change them. Same format as cases.json; how to fill it is in docs/assistant-plan.md, 12, "The held-out set". Run it alone: node eval/assistant/run-eval.mjs http://localhost:8081 --cases heldout.json --label heldout-1
